
### cache exercise (1)  {.smaller}


```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: max-age=300
ETag: 1234-5678
```
<hr/>
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Cache-Control: no-cache
Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 03:33:13 GMT
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 04:53:13 GMT
```
<hr/>
For which of the above: 

* reuse cached response in 1 minute? 10 minutes?
* reuse cached response after checking server in 1 minute? 10 minutes?
